# Nie Chang

> Official academic profile of Nie Chang (聂畅), a final-year Ph.D. researcher at Shanghai Jiao Tong University working on Physical AI, embodied intelligence, agentic robot systems, Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.

This file is a concise guide to the public, human-readable pages on the site. Publication status and venue information reflect the corresponding publication page. The English site is the default; a complete Chinese version is also available.

## Profile

- [English academic profile](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/): Biography, research interests, education, research vision, selected work, robot demonstrations, and contact information.
- [中文学术主页](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/): Chinese version of the academic profile.
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Tc2sl7gAAAAJ): Author profile and citation record.
- [IRMV Lab](https://irmv.sjtu.edu.cn/): Research laboratory at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

## Research Interests

- Physical AI & Embodied Intelligence
- Agentic Robot System
- Large Language Model (LLM) & Vision Language Model (VLM)
- Vision-Language-Action Model (VLA)

## Publications

- [Publications](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/): Ten works with complete author lists, venue and publication status, method figures, topic keywords, abstracts, and technical summaries.
- [Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm: The HEAR Framework for Sound-Centric Manipulation](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/hear/): Published in The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR).
- [Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/tgl/): Under review at IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO).
- [ERMV: Editing 4D Robotic Multi-view Images to Enhance Embodied Agents](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/ermv/): Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT).
- [MID: A Self-Supervised Multimodal Iterative Denoising Framework](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/mid/): Published in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS).
- [MRASfM: Multi-Camera Reconstruction and Aggregation through Structure-from-Motion in Driving Scenes](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/mrasfm/): IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026); Nie Chang and Lingfeng Xuan contributed equally.
- [Voxelized 3D Gaussian Representation for Dense Visual SLAM on Embedded Vision System](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/vcgs-slam/): Accepted by the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV) in 2026.
- [MovSAM: A Single-image Moving Object Segmentation Framework Based on Deep Thinking](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/movsam/): IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025).
- [DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/diffsac/): Under review at the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV).
- [RLSAC: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Sample Consensus for End-to-End Robust Estimation](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/rlsac/): IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV 2023); Nie Chang and Guangming Wang contributed equally.

## Research Demonstrations

- [HEAR project](https://hear.irmv.top/): Sound-centric real-robot manipulation, project details, and demonstrations.

## Engineering Projects

- [Engineering project index](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/): Flagship engineering deployments spanning AI for Science laboratory robotics, autonomous driving production lines, and 3D visual geometry.
- [Multi-Camera SfM for 4D Vision Auto-Annotation](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/sfm/): Production-deployed 4D vision auto-annotation pipeline at Hozon/NETA Auto, delivering 95%+ reconstruction speedups (from 30-40 min down to 1-1.5 min), 4.77% dense depth accuracy surpassing OEM thresholds, and 3x angular drift reduction. Nie Chang led the end-to-end technical route, architecture, and engineering delivery.
- [Automated Valet Parking](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/avp/): Full-stack L4 AVP system deployed across campus and multi-floor underground parking facilities with Voyager Tech, featuring real-time surround BEV multi-task perception, decimeter-level localization fusion, and kinematic Hybrid A* + IPOPT trajectory optimization. Nie Chang served as project lead and chief architect.
- [Autonomous Lawn Robot: LiDAR Obstacle Perception and Multi-Sensor Fusion](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/mower/): Commercial-grade autonomous mower deployed across diverse turf environments with Positec (WORX), featuring non-planar terrain modeling, 7cm micro-trench hazard detection, and factor-graph RTK/LiDAR/IMU fusion. Nie Chang led system architecture and perception-fusion delivery.
- [Robotic Chemist](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/robot-chemist/): High-precision dual-arm mobile manipulation for AI for Science chemistry laboratories, integrating 3DGS sim-to-real digital twins, millimeter-level delicate labware manipulation, and closed-loop centrifuge workflows. Nie Chang led dual-arm manipulation and sim-to-real transfer.
- [Low-Speed Autonomous Research Vehicle](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/lsv/): Ground-up hardware and software autonomy platform built across low-speed vehicles and 4WIS AGVs, establishing an end-to-end ROS autonomy stack with 8 real-vehicle closed-loop demonstrations.

## Factory Material Handling

- [Dual-arm mobile material handling](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/factory-material-handling/): Heavy-payload industrial mobile manipulation system achieving sub-centimeter pallet localization, millimeter-level 6D pose estimation, and synchronized dual-arm de-palletizing under extreme factory vibrations. Nie Chang spearheaded pose estimation and dual-arm coordination.
- [工厂搬运机器人](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/factory-material-handling/): 工业级重载双臂自主移动操作平台，攻克毫米级位姿估计与振动干扰下双臂协同拆垛难题。

- [DTFI: LiDAR-camera fusion and IMM-UKF tracking (TETCI 2023)](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/dtfi/): Chang Nie, Zhiyang Ju, Zhifeng Sun, Hui Zhang. 30 Hz real-time highway perception with deep feature fusion and IMM-UKF tracking, achieving 86.00% Mostly Tracked (MT) and sub-1% Mostly Lost (ML) on KITTI. DOI: 10.1109/TETCI.2023.3259441. [中文](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/publications/dtfi/).
